# EA Engagement Models

**← Back to [Foundation](../README.md) • [EAP Home](../../README.md)**

---

> This section documents organizational partnership models that define how the Enterprise Architecture Practice collaborates with different business units. Each model establishes dedicated architectural resources, governance integration points, and structured collaboration frameworks.

_For general EA service requests and support, see **[Engaging the EA Team](../engaging-ea.md)**._

---
page_texts.2:
[foundation/engagements/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Organizational engagement models establish formal partnership frameworks between the EA Practice and specific business units. These models define dedicated architectural resources, clear accountability structures (RACI), and integrated governance workflows tailored to each unit's unique needs.
page_texts.3:
[foundation/engagements/README.md#partnership-principles]

### Partnership Principles

- **Dedicated Resources**: Assigned architects with deep domain expertise
- **Clear Accountability**: RACI matrices defining roles and responsibilities
- **Governance Integration**: Seamless connection to enterprise governance processes
- **Continuous Partnership**: Ongoing collaboration from strategy through operations
